core_obligations: Identify the tensor product against the colimit with the colimit of the tensor products (proof lines 14324-14327).
Use exactness of filtered colimits to conclude that K-flatness is inherited (proof lines 14328-14332).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a colimit of a system of K-flat complexes, and more generally any filtered colimit of K-flat complexes, is again K-flat. The proof uses that taking termwise colimits commutes with forming the total tensor product against a fixed complex, so that the total complexes computing the tensor product against the colimit are colimits of the corresponding total complexes for the approximating complexes. Since filtered colimits are exact, a quasi-isomorphism computing the derived tensor product for each approximation produces one for the colimit.
